text: In the hyperparameter chapter, the spectral radius ρ is described primarily as the control for what?
choices: The number of neurons in the reservoir
The ridge regularization strength of the readout
The sparsity (fraction of nonzero weights) of W_rec
The memory timescale — how quickly the reservoir forgets past inputs
explanation: Section 8.2 calls ρ the 'master knob' that sets the timescale over which the reservoir forgets (MC_k ∝ ρ^{2k}). Reservoir size is N, regularization is λ, and sparsity is the connectivity p — each a separate hyperparameter.
